parts.notes: Exact K141 annotated overview points LED arrow to this independent native top-notch light pipe. Previously mislabeled upper-latch; preserve all source triangles, bind only real front RGB output, exclude from shell recoloring.

limitations: Native manufacturer enclosure/Stamp cover/key/light-pipe geometry retained without scaling; model appearance does not establish runtime support.
Main enclosure PCB layout is unknown and stays neutral UNKNOWN. Stamp module adds a black1mm board envelope with UNKNOWN on hidden back; PIN1.27 mounting details are not fabricated.

Only externally visible rear screw heads and brass M3collars added from exact photographs/native hole centers. Head dimensions and materials are approximate; hidden shafts, threads and standoffs remain unverified.
No physical hardware or calibrated optical measurements. Front RGB is bound to the native light pipe identified by official annotation; internal Stamp LED remains covered/unmapped in3D.

Stamp paper registration uses77mm front shell, separately from80mm rear-latch envelope. The unchanged paper intentionally spans native cover pockets as in the photograph; its alpha-visible outer boundary remains within the carrier.

External USB-C, 23 screw heads, wire-entry terminals, DC, PWR-CAN/PWR-485, GPIO.EXT and microSD geometry are reconstructed from K141 photos/native apertures. Visible geometry +/-0.4mm, concealed contact and cavity depths remain estimates; not manufacturing-fit CAD.
All six exterior directions compared; camera/lighting, pixel resolution and absent complete assembly CAD prevent a 100% photo-identical or manufacturing-accuracy claim.
assemblyNotes: Original manufacturer components selected from assembled cluster; other components excluded with reasons. One rigid global transform, no scaling. No native part is moved or scaled in this refresh. Added fasteners use exact back-hole centers; source photo sizes are separately approximate. Stamp paper canvas is registered to the77mm front face, not the rear-latch-inclusive80mm envelope. 2026-11-06 exterior refresh keeps every native triangle and global transform; fixes USB frame and terminal recesses, adds independently oriented hollow side connectors and original-pixel side labels. Left insert correction seats PWR485/PWR-CAN and both bus switches at native cut-out Y=12mm; carrier bodies and contacts move together. No native mesh, paper, screen, front Grove anchor or external envelope changes.

facts.label: Paper and optical face isolation

facts.method: Fixed original-pixel masks and independent mm planes; source images are unmodified except alpha and crop. Recess plane selected from manufacturer CAD planar-face audit.
facts.uncertainty: Paper boundary +/-0.3mm; optical cover diameter +/-0.5mm. Printed-paper images do not establish calibrated optics or firmware output.
